explanation: A feeling of meaninglessness and emptiness, which the Preacher describes as a central part of human experience.
Everything connected to the world and physical life, in contrast to the spiritual or eternal.
The shortness and transience of everything in the world, which the Preacher points out to show the meaninglessness of life.
The ability to understand and judge rightly, something the Preacher seeks but finds unsatisfying in light of life's meaninglessness.
Effort and activity carried out to achieve a goal, often linked to one's profession. The Preacher sees work as a source of emptiness and meaninglessness.
A continuous sequence of events and moments, which the Preacher claims moves in cycles and repeats itself.
A symbol of nature's cyclical patterns and the transience of human life, which the Preacher uses to emphasize life's emptiness.
